case_name: Avula Yamuna vs Neeli Venkata Naresh Babu

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: wife, seeking restitution of conjugal rights and maintenance

facts_of_case: Matrimonial disputes between spouses. Wife seeks restitution of conjugal rights, maintenance, and domestic violence relief. Husband files for dissolution of marriage. Cases pending before various courts.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking to transfer a case to establish that there is no other reasonable alternative.
legal_principles.held: Perused the record. It is very difficult for her to travel to attend the divorce case proceedings without any male support.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking to transfer a case must demonstrate that there is no other reasonable alternative.
legal_principles.held: It is very difficult for her to travel to attend the divorce case proceedings without any male support.

outcome.final_order: All further proceedings in F.C.O.P.No.23 of 2023 stayed till 12.09.2025. Petitioner permitted to take out personal notice to respondent through Registered Post with Acknowledgment Due.
